issues.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel) on the ES300
issues.sym: Blue smoke from the tailpipe, oil level dropping between changes, a check engine light, or in bad cases the oil pressure light and ticking or knocking.
issues.why: Oil in this V6 could thicken into gel or sludge, especially when oil changes were stretched out. The sludge blocks oil passages and starves the engine. Toyota and Lexus set up a special policy for affected engines.
issues.next: Stop driving if the oil pressure light comes on. Have the engine checked for sludge, keep oil changes frequent, and ask a Lexus dealer whether any special policy help still applies.
src: Lexus TSB 010102 (special policy, engine oil gel)

issues.t: Driver airbag cover may tear (campaign 1LG)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. You may see a split or bulge in the steering wheel airbag cover, or the airbag light may be on.
issues.why: On some early cars the driver airbag module cover could tear, which could affect how the airbag deploys. Lexus ran a campaign to replace the driver airbag module.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open campaigns and have the airbag module replaced if it was never done.

issues.t: Hesitation, surging or harsh shifts in the automatic
issues.sym: A pause when pulling away or accelerating from a coast, a small surge in speed at steady throttle, or a clunk on some shifts.
issues.why: The shift logic in the engine and transmission computer could hold or change gears awkwardly. Lexus released service bulletins with updated computer calibration to smooth the shifting.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer to check whether the shift calibration update has been applied, and make sure the transmission fluid is at the right level and in good condition.
src: Lexus TSB TC00403 (ECM calibration, shifting enhancement)

issues.t: Front brake vibration when stopping
issues.sym: A shake or pulsing felt in the steering wheel or brake pedal when braking, mostly from highway speed.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for front brake vibration on these years, usually traced to uneven rotor thickness.
issues.next: Have the front rotors measured and resurfaced or replaced, and make sure the wheel lug nuts are tightened evenly to spec.

issues.t: Front power window regulator can bend
issues.sym: A front window moves slowly, makes grinding or clicking noises, sits crooked, or drops into the door.
issues.why: The front door window regulators on these cars could deform over time with normal use, and Lexus issued a bulletin covering it.
issues.next: Have the regulator inspected and replaced with the updated part if the window starts acting up.
src: Lexus TSB 00903 (front door power window regulators may deform)

issues.t: Throttle body may set the check engine light (campaign 3LF)
issues.sym: Check engine light, sometimes with reduced power or an uneven idle.
issues.why: An electrical contact inside the electronic throttle body could malfunction. Lexus ran a special service campaign to inspect and replace the throttle body.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open campaigns and have the throttle body inspected or replaced at a dealer.

issues.t: VVT-i oil hose can burst
issues.sym: A sudden oil leak at the engine, oil pressure warning light, burning oil smell, or engine noise.
issues.why: The oil line that feeds the variable valve timing system had a rubber section that could break down with age and split. Lexus replaced it with an all-metal line under a limited service campaign.
issues.next: Confirm the campaign was done on your VIN. If the oil light comes on, pull over and shut the engine off right away to avoid engine damage.

issues.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
issues.sym: Oil seeping down the front or passenger side of the engine, drips under the car, or a burning oil smell.
issues.why: The sealant on the front timing chain cover of this V6 can leak. Lexus issued a bulletin for the repair, and it is one of the most reported problems on early ES 350s.
issues.next: Keep an eye on the oil level and have the leak diagnosed. The fix means resealing the timing cover, which is a big job, so get it done before oil loss becomes serious.
src: Lexus TSB 01007 (2GR-FE front timing cover oil leak)

issues.t: Ticking or rattle with cam timing codes
issues.sym: A ticking or brief rattle from the engine, often at cold start, sometimes with a check engine light for camshaft timing codes.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for engine ticking along with valve timing trouble codes on this V6, tied to parts of the variable valve timing system.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about the bulletin. Do not ignore a timing code, and keep oil changes on schedule.
src: Lexus TSB LSB-0028-09 (engine ticking noise, DTC P0014-P0025)

issues.t: Torque converter shudder
issues.sym: A shake or vibration like driving over rumble strips at light throttle, usually at steady cruising speeds.
issues.why: The torque converter lock-up clutch could shudder on early ES 350s. Lexus issued a bulletin for the repair.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer confirm the shudder and check for the bulletin repair. Fixing it early helps protect the transmission.
src: Lexus TSB L-SB-0027-08 (torque converter shudder, 2007-2008 ES 350)

issues.t: Clunk or knock from the steering shaft
issues.sym: A clunk or knocking noise felt through the steering wheel when turning, especially at low speed or over bumps.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for noise from the steering intermediate shaft on early ES 350s.
issues.next: Have the steering checked to confirm where the noise is coming from, and ask about the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall 09V-388)
issues.sym: The accelerator sticks down or feels hard to release, especially with an all-weather mat or a second mat stacked on top.
issues.why: The pedal shape and some floor mats allowed the pedal to catch on the mat. It was part of a large Toyota and Lexus recall that reshaped or replaced the pedal.
issues.next: Remove loose or stacked mats and check the VIN for open recalls. If the pedal ever sticks, shift to neutral and brake firmly.

issues.t: Dashboard turns sticky, shiny or cracked
issues.sym: The top of the dash goes soft, sticky and shiny, glares into the windshield in sunlight, or cracks.
issues.why: The dashboard material breaks down with heat and humidity. Lexus ran warranty enhancement programs to replace affected dashboards.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer whether your car was covered and whether coverage still applies. A dash cover cuts the glare in the meantime.

issues.t: Water pump leaks coolant
issues.sym: Pink crust or drips at the front of the engine, coolant level slowly dropping, or a sweet smell after driving.
issues.why: The water pump seal on this V6 commonly starts seeping well before the rest of the engine is worn.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level and replace the pump once it leaks. Do not let it run low, since overheating can damage the engine.

issues.t: Pre-collision system can brake on its own (recall 15V-728)
issues.sym: The car brakes hard for no reason, often when driving over a steel plate or joint in the road.
issues.why: On cars with the optional Pre-Collision System, the radar could mistake a steel road plate for an obstacle and apply the brakes.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the free repair done. Until it is fixed, stay alert to sudden braking, especially on bridges.

issues.t: ES 300h check engine light for hybrid inverter code
issues.sym: Check engine light and possibly hybrid system warnings on the ES 300h.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for a generator inverter fault code on these hybrids that calls for a dealer diagnosis and repair.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer read the codes and check for the bulletin. Do not ignore hybrid system warnings.

issues.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall 20V-682)
issues.sym: Rough running, a check engine light, the engine not starting, or stalling while driving.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank could fail. Toyota recalled many Toyota and Lexus models to install an improved pump.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the free pump replacement. If the engine stumbles or stalls, get it to a dealer rather than continuing to drive.

issues.t: ES 300h brake booster pump may fail (recall 19V-544)
issues.sym: Brake and stability control warning lights, and a brake pedal that needs more effort to stop the car.
issues.why: The pump that supplies brake assist on the hybrid could fail, which turns off stability control and reduces power braking.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If brake warnings appear, drive carefully to a dealer or have the car towed.

issues.t: ES 300h engine casting may crack and leak coolant (recall 20V-064)
issues.sym: Coolant level dropping, coolant puddles, or the engine running hot.
issues.why: Some engines had porosity in the castings that could crack and leak coolant. Dealers inspect and replace the engine if needed.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the temperature gauge rises or coolant keeps disappearing, stop driving and have the car inspected.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy (recall 23V-865)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag light may show off with an adult in the seat, or an airbag warning light may appear.
issues.why: The occupant sensor in the passenger seat could develop a short circuit, which can keep the front passenger airbag from deploying. Covers 2020-2021 ES and 2020-2022 ES hybrid.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the sensor inspected and replaced. Until then, avoid seating adults up front if the passenger airbag shows off.

issues.t: ES 300h backup camera image may be delayed (recall 24V-124)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture is slow to appear or does not show when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Software in the parking assist computer could delay the rearview image. Dealers update the software for free.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the software update. Look over your shoulder and use the mirrors when backing up until it is done.

issues.t: Steering tie rod lock nut may loosen (recall 17V-415)
issues.sym: Looseness or a clunk in the steering, the car wandering, or the steering wheel sitting off-centre.
issues.why: On a small batch of cars the lock nut that holds the right-side tie rod to the steering rack may not have been tightened properly. If it backs off, the tie rod can work loose and steering control can be lost.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the dealer inspect the nut before driving much further. If the steering suddenly feels loose, stop and have the car towed.

issues.t: Brake actuator seal may be damaged (recall 16V-198)
issues.sym: Often nothing obvious. Stability control or ABS may not work as well as it should in a skid, and a brake or stability warning light may come on.
issues.why: A sealing ring inside the ABS and stability control actuator may have been damaged during assembly, which can upset brake fluid pressure inside the unit.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the dealer inspect the brake actuator. Get it looked at promptly if a brake or stability warning light is on.
